title: Design: Lock and info tooltips on COD look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png, ct-p1-03-info-tooltip-cod.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Settings page.
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, click "Credit Terms".
  2. Hover the lock icon on the COD row.
  3. Hover the info icon on the COD row.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Credit Terms page opens on the Active tab.

Step 2:

  • A dark grey box with white text opens to the right of the icon, over the Due text of the COD row, with no arrow, reading on two lines "Always available." and "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." (as in ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png).

Step 3:

  • The same kind of box opens to the right of the icon reading "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created." (as in ct-p1-03-info-tooltip-cod.png).

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R8, COD info icon: “COD: "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created."”
  • S1-R9: “Hovering the lock icon shows "Always available." with the line "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." below it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the lock on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold | "Always available." / "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." | Tooltip on hover”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the info icon on COD | "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created." | Tooltip on hover”
